strength.excerpt: To be counted as unemployed, a person generally must have been without work during the reference week, available for work, and actively searching for a job during the four-week period ending with that week.
strength.reason: Gives readers a clear, concrete account of the core criteria.

strength.excerpt: By contrast, someone whose only job-search activity was browsing listings has not met the active-search requirement.
strength.reason: The example makes an abstract classification rule easy to follow.

weakness.excerpt: These conditions determine who is classified as unemployed and included alongside employed people in the rate’s denominator.
weakness.reason: The closing restates the opening’s point without adding a takeaway or impact.

weakness.excerpt: A person on temporary layoff who expects to be recalled may qualify without actively searching.
weakness.reason: The exception adds useful detail, but the piece remains narrowly procedural and offers little broader context.
